name: PMO KRI Status
query: SELECT name AS "KRI:Link/PMO KRI:200", kri_name AS "KRI Name:Data:220", risk AS "Risk:Link/PMO Enterprise Risk:180", current_value AS "Current:Float:110", threshold AS "Threshold:Float:110", status AS "Status:Data:100", measurement_date AS "Measurement Date:Date:120" FROM `tabPMO KRI` ORDER BY FIELD(status, 'Red','Amber','Green'), kri_name
